title: ERR-4021 revoked API key
text: Error ERR-4021 means the API key you sent has been revoked. Generate a new key in the dashboard under Settings, API keys, and update your environment before retrying.

title: ERR-4210 payload too large
text: Error ERR-4210 means the request body exceeded the 2 MB payload limit. Split the batch into smaller chunks and send them sequentially.

title: ERR-5003 upstream timeout
text: Error ERR-5003 is an upstream timeout from the model provider. Retry with exponential backoff. It is not caused by anything wrong in your request.

title: HTTP 402 spend cap reached
text: A 402 Payment Required response means your workspace has exceeded its monthly spend cap. Raise the cap in Billing or wait for the next cycle to begin.

title: Credential hygiene
text: Replace your access secrets on a regular schedule so that a leaked secret has a short useful life. Retire the previous secret only after the replacement is confirmed working in production.

title: Seats and members
text: Each member of your workspace consumes one seat. Removing a member frees their seat at the end of the current billing period, not immediately.

title: Password reset for directory members
text: Members who sign in through your identity provider cannot change a password here. Password changes happen in your provider's directory and take effect on next sign-in.

title: Password reset for local accounts
text: Members with a local account can reset their password from the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 30 minutes and can only be used once.

title: Rate limits
text: Requests are limited to 60 per minute per key. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 together with a Retry-After header telling you how long to pause.

title: Log retention
text: Prompt and completion logs are retained for 30 days and then permanently deleted. Retention cannot be extended on the current plan.

title: Model deprecation
text: When a model is retired you receive 60 days notice by email. Requests sent after the retirement date fall back to the closest supported model rather than failing.

title: Streaming responses
text: Enable token by token delivery by setting stream to true. The reply then arrives as server sent events instead of one complete JSON body at the end.

title: Request timeouts
text: The default request timeout is 120 seconds. It can be lowered per request but cannot be raised above 300 seconds on any plan.

title: Invoices
text: Download invoices from Billing, Invoices. Invoices are issued on the first of each month and include VAT where applicable to your country.

title: Workspace regions
text: Workspaces are pinned to a single region when created and cannot be migrated later. Create a new workspace if you need a different region.

title: Webhook signature verification
text: Verify that a webhook came from us by comparing the X-Signature header against an HMAC of the raw request body computed with your signing secret.
